column1: # replays EVERY row on every run before exploring. Never delete a row: when the
# engine defect is fixed or the fixture establishes its prerequisites, flip
# `expect` to pass (and keep the row) so the seed stays a regression guard.
# Columns (tab-separated): test  var  seed  expect(pass|fail)  classification  note
#   var: CW_TEST_SEED (clock-seeded default) or CW_TEST_SEED_FORCE (overrides a
# test_lava_aabb_golden: 45/200 of odd seeds 1..399 failed "A side-overlap mob
# fire: actual=600 expected=601" (8e93dc05). Identical per-seed outcome with
# d2e471b6 reverted, so not a code change. The case's tick 1 runs before the
# loop that re-pins the creeper's position/velocity, so the random draws decide
# whether the burning-box +1 lands: the fixture assumes a tick-1 geometry it
# does not establish. Instrumented (scratch, 2026-09-25): spawn_creeper's random
# initial velocity is applied in tick 1; seeds whose x velocity is <= ~-0.136
# no strict overlap with the lava cell at x=9 -> no burning-box +1; passing
# seeds (3: -0.0985, 7: -0.1282) stay inside. Engine behaviour is consistent;
# the fixture must zero the spawn velocity (or assert the overlap) before tick 1.
# test_giant_box_golden: case 6b "width lava x=2, west chunk resident, fire:
# actual=600 expected=601" -- same class (24aca0d6: the clock seed moved the
# giant off the lava side cell); found by --explore-scenarios, seed base
# RESOLUTION 2026-09-25 (same day): the spawn helper's random initial velocity
# is NOT Beta (Entity/EntityLiving constructors set no motion; SpawnerAnimals
# / TileEntityMobSpawner / EntitySlime children set none either) -- CaveWii's
# server_local_spawn_monster_at adds a random 0.05..0.25 vector and draws 4
# World.rand values for it (engine parity question, reported separately, NOT
# changed here). lava_aabb, giant_box and mob_lava_demo now zero it before
# tick 1 and assert their contact prerequisite before AND after the tick: all
# their rows flipped to expect=pass (fixture-assumption, fixed).
# test_mob_lava_aabb_golden (already spawned at rest): its 3 rows stay
# expect=fail. Instrumented: the S0 control spider moves +0.0437 x on tick 1
# start a wander path on the first tick (rand.nextInt(80) x2) and moveEntity
# steps along it; CaveWii's port does the same. The control sat EXACTLY on
# the face, so Beta itself would sometimes burn it. Lead decision (same day):
# the control's purpose is "out of reach" -> moved to x 7.8 (maxX 8.5, 0.5
# block off the face), prerequisite asserted before/after tick 1, expected
# 20 / -1 unchanged; its 4 rows flipped to expect=pass.
# G1 review F1 (same day): moving the control lost the only exact-face

# actual=19 expected=20" (3/100, seed base 0925b) -- the control spider's
